content.text:
The Hot New AI Stock That’s Really Behind the Dow’s Gains—and It’s Not Alphabet
If the Dow’s ascent to 52,000 were a World Cup match, then Alphabet involvement was akin to a soccer player being substituted on in the final moments and scoring the fourth goal in a 4-0 win.
